summary: At the desk, {person} explains which year's benefits depend on signing by a particular date.
realLife: New York ambulance bill sponsors asked for signature by September 30 because a later start would delay the benefit to providers by a year.
gates: A documented implementation cutoff and its consequence for the benefit year.
inGame: needs: a documented implementation cutoff and its consequence for the benefit year.

turns.what: Give providers the applicable benefit year.
turns.writesBack: Save the effective period with the notice.

turns.what: Ask the administering office for the next applicable period.
turns.writesBack: Keep the missed start on the calendar.
